title: Rank SMP
description: This plugin is like the popular Ranked SMP, each player gets assigned a rank, better ranks = more hearts, extra inventory space etc, xp boost
body:
# 🏆 Ranked SMP

Welcome to Ranked SMP, a competitive survival experience where progression, PvP, and strategy decide who truly rules the server.

This project is an accurate recreation of the original Ranked SMP, bringing all the core mechanics, balance, and gameplay systems into one place.

# ⚔️ Core Features
📈 Ranking System
Climb the ranks by defeating players and proving your dominance. Every fight matters.
💀 Lives System
Death has consequences. Lose your lives and risk elimination — play smart or pay the price.
🪓 Competitive PvP
Balanced mechanics designed for fair and skill-based combat.
🌍 Vanilla+ Survival
Classic survival experience enhanced with ranked progression.
🔒 High Stakes Gameplay
Every decision counts — alliances, betrayals, and battles shape the world.
🧠 Gameplay Overview

Start as a fresh player and work your way up through the ranks.
Gain points by eliminating others, survive longer than your enemies, and become one of the top players on the server.

But be careful — losing too many fights can cost you everything.

# 🎯 Perfect For
Players who enjoy competitive survival
Fans of hardcore-style SMPs
PvP-focused players looking for progression-based gameplay
Groups who want high-stakes multiplayer experiences

# ⚙️ Technical Info
Designed to replicate the original Ranked SMP experience
Optimized for smooth multiplayer gameplay
Easy to install and run

# 📌 Notes

This is a faithful recreation, meaning mechanics, balance, and systems are intentionally kept as close to the original as possible.

# ❤️ Credits

All credit for the original concept goes to the creators of Ranked SMP.
This project is a recreation made for accessibility and community use.
